name: Squarespace Commerce
notes: Checkout structure is still derived, not driven. What IS observed (letteringworks.com, 2026-07-20): the bench stalls at `detect` with 'could not reach checkout' because the add-to-cart control carries no matching button TEXT — a text-based add-to-cart cascade finds nothing even after the commerce block hydrates. Target `.sqs-add-to-cart-button` by class instead.

steps.addToCart: Click `.sqs-add-to-cart-button` (NOT a text match — the control renders no add/cart innerText), which opens the cart drawer → 'Checkout'.
steps.payment: Stripe Payment Element (Squarespace Payments/Stripe). Card-number token, then the CVV token immediately after.
